<reason>Side A won by proving that animal review frameworks are practically incoherent for cell cultures and counterproductive, as reduction mandates would destroy the Replacement pillar of the 3Rs and prolong real animal suffering. Side A neutralized Side B's fish challenge (noting fish possess nociceptors) and exploited Side B's concession that review would restrict organoid numbers. Side B's functional sentience argument was strong but failed to resolve these practical contradictions.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>Side A's Pressure Questions exposed the mechanism gap in Side B's suffering claim for organoids lacking nociceptors and revealed the fatal contradiction between reduction mandates and replacement strategies, which Side A exploited in Rebuttal 2.</best_rebuttal>
